description: This file implements the Grok Realtime Voice Agent LLM service with WebSocket support, handling real-time audio and text communication, WebSocket connection management, event processing, and context handling for a voice assistant system.

classes.name: CurrentAudioResponse
classes.description: Tracks the current audio response from the assistant, including item ID, content index, start time, and total size of received audio data.

classes.name: GrokRealtimeLLMService
classes.description: Implements a real-time voice agent service with WebSocket communication, handling audio streaming, event processing, context management, and session control for Grok Voice Agent API.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates if the service supports generating usage metrics.

methods.name: set_audio_input_paused
methods.description: Sets whether audio input is paused.

methods.name: _get_configured_sample_rate
methods.description: Retrieves manually configured sample rate for input or output, with special handling for PCM and G.711 formats.

methods.name: _get_output_sample_rate
methods.description: Returns the output sample rate, assuming session properties are set.

methods.name: _is_turn_detection_enabled
methods.description: Checks if server-side VAD (Voice Activity Detection) is enabled.

methods.name: _handle_interruption
methods.description: Handles user interruption of assistant speech, including sending cancel events and stopping metrics.

methods.name: _handle_user_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles event when user starts speaking (implementation placeholder).

methods.name: _handle_user_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles event when user stops speaking, sending buffer commit and create events.

methods.name: _handle_bot_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles event when bot stops speaking, clearing current audio response.

methods.name: _calculate_audio_duration_ms
methods.description: Calculates audio duration in milliseconds based on total bytes and sample rate.

methods.name: _truncate_current_audio_response
methods.description: Attempts to truncate current audio response, best-effort cleanup.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service, establishing WebSocket connection and initializing session properties.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service and disconnects WebSocket.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the service and disconnects WebSocket.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling different frame types and updating state accordingly.

methods.name: _handle_context
methods.description: Handles updates to the LLM context.

methods.name: _handle_messages_append
methods.description: Placeholder for handling message appending to context (not yet implemented).

methods.name: send_client_event
methods.description: Sends a client event over WebSocket.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection to Grok.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection and cleans up.

methods.name: _ws_send
methods.description: Sends a message over WebSocket.

methods.name: _update_settings
methods.description: Updates session settings on the server based on current context.

methods.name: _receive_task_handler
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages and dispatches events.

methods.name: _handle_evt_conversation_created
methods.description: Handles 'conversation.created' event, triggers settings update.

methods.name: _handle_evt_response_created
methods.description: Placeholder for handling 'response.created' event (not yet implemented).

methods.name: _handle_evt_session_updated
methods.description: Handles 'session.updated' event, marks session as ready and triggers response creation if needed.

methods.name: _handle_evt_audio_delta
methods.description: Handles streaming audio data from assistant, decoding base64 and pushing frames.

methods.name: _handle_evt_audio_done
methods.description: Handles end of audio stream, pushing TTSStoppedFrame.

methods.name: _handle_evt_conversation_item_added
methods.description: Handles new conversation items, tracking function calls and updating assistant response state.

methods.name: _handle_evt_input_audio_transcription_completed
methods.description: Handles completed audio transcription, pushing transcription frames.

methods.name: _handle_evt_response_done
methods.description: Handles end of response, processes usage metrics, updates conversation, and handles errors.

methods.name: _handle_evt_audio_transcript_delta
methods.description: Handles incremental transcript text, pushing text frames.

methods.name: _push_output_transcript_text_frames
methods.description: Pushes LLMTextFrame and TTSTextFrame for transcript text.

methods.name: _handle_evt_function_call_arguments_done
methods.description: Processes completed function call arguments, triggers function execution.

methods.name: _handle_evt_speech_started
methods.description: Handles speech start event, truncates current response, broadcasts user start frame.

methods.name: _handle_evt_speech_stopped
methods.description: Handles speech stop event, starts metrics, broadcasts user stop frame.

methods.name: _handle_evt_error
methods.description: Handles error events, pushing error message.

methods.name: reset_conversation
methods.description: Resets the conversation by disconnecting and reconnecting.

methods.name: _create_response
methods.description: Creates an assistant response, setting up conversation if needed, and sending response creation event.

methods.name: _process_completed_function_calls
methods.description: Processes completed function calls and optionally sends results.

methods.name: _send_user_audio
methods.description: Encodes and sends user audio buffer to Grok.

methods.name: _send_tool_result
methods.description: Sends function call output result to Grok.

methods.name: create_context_aggregator
methods.description: Creates context aggregators for the Grok Realtime service.
